metadata.case_name: TSUI WAI HO v. PRIDE GLORY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: Clerk in a social service organization (NGO)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Assistant Clerical Officer (ACO) at Death Registry, Immigration Department

source: X-ray left ankle revealed fracture distal fibula.
left ankle fracture resulting in pain, weakness and stiffness
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: tenderness, bruises and swollen left ankle
mild residual pain from time to time, especially when there is a change of weather

treatments_received.treatment: open reduction and internal fixation of fracture
source: he received an operation of open reduction and internal fixation of his fracture.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

source: On 24 Jul 2015, Mr Tsui underwent an operation of removal of his left ankle implant at RH.

Mr Tsui was also referred to Physiotherapy Department (PH) of Queen Elizabeth Hospital (QEH) for physiotherapy and occupational therapy. He attended altogether a total of 13 sessions until 6 Dec 2013.

losses.description: Left ankle fracture resulting in pain, weakness and stiffness with mild residual pain and some limitation of movement earlier; made satisfactory recovery but with occasional mild pain thereafter.
